analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY in confirmed uptrend (+4.2% vs SMA50, 20d slope +5.09%) — environment is constructive for longs, but that is not a mandate to force new trades.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW: All five positions remain thesis-intact. (1) A (Agilent): +0.89%, at 45% of 52w range, uptrend basing, earnings August 26 — hold. (2) ADP: -1.32%, basing uptrend, high-quality payroll compounder still above stop — hold. (3) FICO: -0.22%, small position, basing at 26% of range, EPS revisions positive — hold. (4) IQV: -0.92%, basing at 27% of range; flag: earnings July 21 (36 days) are approaching — no thesis break yet but monitor closely for any guidance softness; consider trimming if it fades into earnings. (5) LII: +2.67%, the clearest winner, above entry, industrials cycle tailwind — hold.

NEW TRADE DECISION — CASH IS CORRECT TODAY: We are already at 5 positions, which is the stated maximum for this concentrated strategy. Headroom is $24,910. Several candidates are interesting on fundamentals — WDAY (fwd P/E 10.52, PEG 0.51, $3.1B FCF) is an emerging watchlist name if it builds a tighter base; APP (59% rev growth, 78% op margin) is compelling but ATR of 7.1% creates wide stops and we have no room for a 6th position; CDW and TDG are fair-valued industrials/tech distributors with decent setups but nothing asymmetric. GOOGL/GOOG and APH are too extended at 87-88% of 52w range — late-cycle entries inconsistent with the Weinstein framework. Forcing a 6th position to deploy cash would violate both the concentration discipline and the 'cash is a position' principle. The portfolio heat is low (1.40%), max drawdown is 0%, and profit factor is barely above 1x — this is not a time to stretch. Preserve the $30k cash reserve as dry powder for a genuine asymmetric setup or to add to a winning existing position on a healthy pullback. Confidence that this disciplined hold-and-wait stance preserves capital and beats a passive SPY+cash blend on a risk-adjusted basis is moderate — the uptrend is supportive but the concentrated quality book already captures it without dilution.
